context: Saito explains mental rest to a tired patient.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical advice; clinical vocabulary (脳/身体/リスク/感覚/知れ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 最近、集中できないんです。
lines.style: tired office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 脳が、休みを求めている感覚ですね。
lines.en: It's the sense that your brain wants rest.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 身体は元気なのに、不思議です。
lines.en: My body's fine, so it's strange.
lines.style: puzzled office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 身体と脳の疲れは、別の感覚です。
lines.en: Bodily and mental fatigue are different sensations.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 放っておくと、リスクはありますか?
lines.en: If I leave it, is there a risk?
lines.style: concerned office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 休めば、リスクは下がると知れますよ。
lines.en: You'll find rest lowers the risk.
lines.style: reassuring doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 感覚を、大事にした方がいいんですね。
lines.en: So I should value those sensations.
lines.style: understanding office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、脳と身体に、休息を。
lines.en: Yes, give rest to your brain and body.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
